description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about goodwill and service failures.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents about goodwill and service failures, last updated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "a paid extra they could not use is refunded to the original payment"; "a failure with no fee, such as a missing special meal, a broken screen or rude service"; "$50 travel credit"; "two or more problems on the same trip: $100 with supervisor approval"; "one goodwill credit per booking". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
